WebSocket endpoint, not a plain GET: open it with an HTTP Upgrade to wss://api.citoapi.com/api/v1/tennis/live/ws. Push feed for live tennis. Requires an API key with tennis access AND the live-WebSocket add-on; without the add-on the upgrade is refused. Auth on the upgrade, any one of: x-api-key header, Authorization: Bearer, ?apiKey= or ?x-api-key= in the query string. On connect the server sends a self-describing {"type":"ready"} frame carrying the protocol and event list, so a client can discover the contract at runtime. Client frames: {"action":"subscribe","rooms":["match:{matchId}","all"]}, {"action":"unsubscribe","rooms":[...]}, {"action":"ping"}. Max 32 rooms per connection. Server frames: {"type":"subscribed"}, {"type":"pong"}, {"type":"error","code":"INVALID_JSON"|"BAD_ROOMS"}, and the events {"type":"POINT_UPDATE"} and {"type":"MATCH_FINISHED"}, each carrying a data object keyed by match_id. matchId values come from /tennis/matches/live. There is no SSE variant for tennis; the WebSocket is the only push transport.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the WebSocket is open.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key on the upgrade request.

403.description: API key lacks tennis access or the live-WebSocket add-on.

**Delay.** Free and Starter plans receive every event 60 seconds late, the same delay as the polled live endpoints. Other plans are real-time.

**Bout ids.** Live payloads (stream, WebSocket, `/ufc/live/{boutId}/state`) carry `boutId` in the live form (`ufc-...`, also the room name) and `cardBoutId`, the id the card itself uses (`/ufc/events/{slug}/bouts`, `/ufc/bouts/{id}`). Join live updates to the card on `cardBoutId`; every endpoint accepts either form.

convention); derived breaks fit within sv_gms in 99.5% of 330,922
fully-populated rows; Alcaraz ATP 2026 comes out 31.3%, the realistic
tour-level band. Only players with at least 100 return games played
qualify (ATP 2026: 987 eligible, top 51.5; WTA 2026: 567 eligible, top

never defaulted. No estimates: a player with no stat rows simply does

tags.description:
Counter-Strike 2: live matches, results, maps, rounds, teams, players, events, rankings, stats and skins.

**Beta.** CS2 is in beta. If anything looks wrong, email support@citoapi.com with the endpoint and the id you called. Docs: https://citoapi.com/docs/api/cs2

**Response shape.** Every response is `{ success, data, meta }`. Lists put rows in `data` and counts or paging in `meta`.

**Ids.** Matches, teams, players and events have ids like `cs2-match-2398421`, `cs2-team-7020`, `cs2-player-11893`, `cs2-event-8038`. Teams, players and events also accept their slug (`vitality`, `zywoo`).

**Paging.** `limit` sets how many rows come back. Each endpoint lists its own maximum (100 on most). Asking for more returns the maximum, not an error. Page with `offset` or `page` where the endpoint lists them.

**Lists are compact.** List endpoints return summary rows. Fetch the single record (`/cs2/events/{eventIdOrSlug}`, `/cs2/teams/{teamIdOrSlug}`) for the full structure.

**Images.** Logos, player photos, map images and event banners are served from `api.citoapi.com` and do not change address. An image field is `null` when we have no image for that record yet. Treat `null` as "no image" and show a placeholder.

**Missing data.** When a record exists but a section has no data yet, the response says so with `data_available: false` and an `unavailable_reason`, rather than an error.

**Times** are ISO 8601 in UTC.
